items.title: Blockchain Association Asks SEC to Double Crypto Startup Exemption to $10 Million
items.summary: The trade group backed Regulation Crypto Assets in its comment letter and asked the Commission to raise both offering caps, write the Howey guidance into the rule, and let third parties file for tokens already trading.

items.title: OCC Finalizes GENIUS Act Stablecoin Rules Ahead of January Deadline
items.summary: The rule sets reserve, redemption and risk standards for issuers, but the OCC has yet to say when it will begin accepting applications.

items.title: OCC's final rule to start fresh in weighing stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
